hero.slogan: Make every resume hit the target
hero.valueProposition: Enter job descriptions with one click, AI intelligently generates perfectly matched resumes for you, easily pass screening, and win interview opportunities.

problem.title: Have you encountered these problems?
problem.subtitle: Resumes sent but no response, few interview opportunities
problem.problem1Desc: Submitted dozens of resumes, but received no replies, don't know where the problem lies
problem.problem2Desc: Using the same resume for all positions, unable to highlight core advantages matching the position
problem.problem3Desc: Resume format or keywords do not meet system requirements, HR cannot even see your resume
problem.atsExplanation: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is used by HR to automatically screen resumes. If your resume format is incorrect or missing keywords, ATS will filter out your resume before HR even sees it.

features.title: No worries, Jobi can help you solve it.
features.description: We provide a seamless resume editing experience to help you create the most competitive customized resumes
features.feature1Desc: No need to re-enter your resume, upload your existing PDF resume, and instantly generate professional resume templates familiar to HR.
features.feature2Desc: Using AI models fine-tuned by job search experts, accurately rewrite resume content based on job descriptions, improving ATS and machine screening pass rates.
features.feature3Desc: Fact-based content modifications and suggestions, avoiding template feel and AI traces, ensuring your resume is authentic and professional.
